media.title: Paris Years — document gallery
media.description: Document gallery for Kaper’s Paris years, 1933–1934. It brings together French and European press documentation, materials relating to French film work, two distinct photographs from the November 1933 reception for Jan Kiepura, and a Paris hotel context image.
media.altText: Gallery card for Bronisław Kaper’s Paris years, combining press items, posters and contextual materials.
media.publicCaption: Gallery of press items, posters and contextual materials relating to Bronisław Kaper’s Paris years and his work in French cinema and theatrical culture, 1933–1934.
media.rightsNote: This gallery has no single rights status. Each member medium carries its own public-domain, licensed, restricted or unresolved-copyright statement; reuse must be assessed item by item.
media.publicCreditLine: Item-level credits identify the holding institution and source for every gallery member.

media.title: L’Informateur de Seine, 30 March 1934 — advertisement for Mariage à responsabilité limitée
media.description: Display advertisement in L’Informateur de Seine, 30 March 1934, for Mariage à responsabilité limitée, the French-language version of Ehe mit beschränkter Haftung, billing Florelle above the title and crediting the music to Kaper and Jurmann.
media.altText: French newspaper advertisement billing Florelle in Mariage à responsabilité limitée, with the music credited to Kaper and Jurmann.
media.rightsNote: Reuse rights are not cleared. The clipping is a display advertisement for the French version of the film, set in display type without an illustration. The archive treats a trade advertisement of this kind as a protected anonymous work, as it does the Kinematograph advertisements of 1930; printed in L’Informateur de Seine on 30 March 1934, its French term of seventy years from publication ran out at the end of 2004, so it was protected on 1 January 1996 and the URAA restored United States copyright to the end of 2029. Gallica supplies the digitised page under conditions governed by French law, which exclude documents protected by a third party’s copyright and leave reuse in another country to the user. Source gallica.bnf.fr / Bibliothèque nationale de France.
